mainEntity.name: What are the different types of pool spillways available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pool spillways come in various styles and materials, each offering a unique aesthetic. Common types include sheer descent spillways, which create a clear, continuous sheet of water; scupper spillways, often made of metal or stone, producing a more focused stream; and natural rock spillways, designed to mimic waterfalls in a natural landscape. Materials range from stainless steel and copper to custom-tiled concrete, natural stone, and acrylic. The choice depends on your pool's design, desired water effect, and overall backyard aesthetic.
